turns:
Summarize this in two sentences:

The town of Millbrook voted on Tuesday to renovate its public library, which was built in 1962 and has not been updated since 1995. The plan, approved by six votes to one, will cost 2.4 million dollars, most of it covered by a state grant, with the remaining 400,000 dollars coming from the town budget. Work will start in March and is expected to take about fourteen months, during which a temporary branch will open in the old fire station on Elm Street. The renovation adds a children's wing, a room for teenagers with computers, and better access for wheelchairs, including a lift to the second floor. Head librarian Ana Ruiz said the building had become too small for the 30,000 visitors it receives every year, and that the new space would also host evening classes for adults learning English.
truth: Two sentences: Millbrook approved (6-1) a $2.4M library renovation (mostly state grant, $400k town), starting March for ~14 months with a temporary branch; it adds children's wing, teen room, wheelchair access because the 1962 building is too small for 30,000 yearly visitors. No invented numbers.
